description: Caduceus (Schiff et al. ICML 2024) DNA foundation model. Repo pins mamba-ssm==1.2.0.post1 / causal-conv1d 1.2 / torch 2.x-cu118 (2024). Must run in a fresh env with torch>=2.5 and transformers>=4.45 on a current GPU node: build/obtain compatible mamba-ssm kernels, load the pretrained Caduceus-PS checkpoint, and reproduce its defining property (reverse-complement equivariance) plus a masked-LM sanity check on human DNA.
